tools.name: search_papers
tools.description:
Search the NobleBlocks paper index by keyword relevance.

        Returns up to `limit` papers with title, authors, year, journal, DOI, citation count,
        an abstract excerpt and a NobleBlocks link. Use get_paper with a result's `id` for
        full metadata, or get_citation to cite it.

tools.name: get_paper
tools.description:
Get full metadata for one paper: authors, journal, volume/issue/pages, DOI, PMID,
        ARK (when the paper has a confirmed NobleID), citation count, abstract and links.

tools.name: get_citation
tools.description:
Format a citation for one paper as BibTeX, RIS or APA 7.

        The URL is the paper's NobleID ARK link when it has a confirmed one, else its DOI link.
        DOIs known to be unreliable are left out rather than guessed.
